title: ansible.schedule Facet
description: The OBSERVED definition of an AWX/AAP schedule, projected read-only by the ansible-automation Connector's controller half (§1.2). An observed foreign object (→ a Stratt Trigger on cutover). Demanded by the AWX-estate governance Baseline awx-schedule-enabled (enabled==true, the disabled/dead-automation audit) and the cutover. rrule is AWX's iCal recurrence; enabled is whether it fires. WIDENED IN PLACE by ADR-0132 D3/D4 rather than versioned as a sibling: this is a Facet on a rebuildable projection, not a wire Contract with external authors, so adding optional properties is backward-compatible widening — the mgmt.address precedent (ADR-0117 D5a widened ADR-0084's closed schema with port). extraDataKeys is the KEY NAMES of a schedule's extra_data and NEVER the values (§2.5): it distinguishes two schedules of one template and shows what a schedule parameterises, without carrying launch-variable content into the graph — the same line ADR-0128 D4 drew when it refused extra_vars on the template. A key like db_password is itself worth seeing: it says a schedule injects secret-shaped material as a launch variable, which should be a CredentialRef. Closed (§9).

timezone.description: the clock the rrule runs on — without it the recurrence is under-determined

nextRunAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the next fire, when scheduled

until.description: RFC3339 UTC last occurrence, when the rule is bounded

extraDataKeys.description: the KEY NAMES of the schedule's extra_data. Values are never projected (§2.5).
